# Test fixtures

* `onenote-2016/OneWithFileData.one` — a OneNote 2016 section with an
  attached file, from Microsoft's
  [Interop-TestSuites](https://github.com/OfficeDev/Interop-TestSuites),
  under the MIT licence in `onenote-2016/LICENSE`, by way of
  [onenote.rs](https://github.com/msiemens/onenote.rs).
* `toc/Open Notebook.onetoc2` — a OneNote table of contents written with
  object revisions, from [onenote.rs](https://github.com/msiemens/onenote.rs),
  under the Mozilla Public License 2.0 (<https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/>).
